system_overview: A model of the classic missionaries and cannibals river-crossing puzzle. Three missionaries and three cannibals must cross a river using a boat that carries at most two people. On either bank, if missionaries are present, they must not be outnumbered by cannibals (otherwise the cannibals would eat them). The boat cannot cross the river empty. The goal is to find a sequence of moves that transports everyone safely from one bank to the other.
actors_and_components: Missionaries: A set of three people who must cross the river without being outnumbered by cannibals on either bank.
Cannibals: A set of three people who must also cross the river. If they outnumber missionaries on a bank where missionaries are present, the missionaries are eaten.
Boat: A vessel that carries one or two people across the river per trip. It cannot travel empty.
state_variables: Which bank the boat is currently docked at (east or west).
A mapping from each bank to the set of people (missionaries and cannibals) currently on that bank.
initial_state: The boat is docked at the east bank. All missionaries and all cannibals are on the east bank. The west bank is empty.
actions: Move: A group of one or two people boards the boat on the current bank and crosses to the opposite bank. This action is only enabled when the resulting configuration on both banks is safe (no missionaries are outnumbered by cannibals on either bank). After the move, the boat is docked at the destination bank, and the people distribution is updated accordingly.
safety_properties: On every bank, if any missionaries are present, cannibals must not outnumber them. Equivalently, either a bank has no missionaries, or the count of cannibals on that bank is less than or equal to the count of missionaries.
The boat carries exactly one or two people per crossing (never zero, never more than two).
additional_assumptions: The puzzle is solved when the east bank becomes empty (everyone has reached the west bank). The specification is designed so that a model checker finding a violation of the 'east bank is non-empty' invariant produces a solution trace.
A bank is considered safe if it contains only cannibals (no missionaries to endanger) or if the number of cannibals does not exceed the number of missionaries.
